mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to this journey where we turn big dreams into real, everyday moments. You know that feeling—when the gap between where you are and where you want to be just seems too wide? That’s exactly what we’re going to explore together. Inspired by Curtis L. Jenkins’ Vision to Reality: Stop Working, Start Living, we’ll shift our focus from the endless grind to the art of living on purpose. What if you could move from simply working hard... to actually living a life that lights you up? We’ll dig into what it really means to find clarity, to plan with intention, and to take action that’s truly aligned with what matters most. There’s this tension we all feel—should we just work harder, or is there something better waiting when we choose to live smarter? Along the way, you’ll find practical wisdom and honest, real-world advice—tools to help you break free from that cycle of busy but unfulfilled. We’ll talk about building habits and systems that support both your personal and professional dreams. And maybe, just maybe, you’ll discover that progress matters so much more than perfection. So, let’s get curious. Let’s challenge what success looks like. Together, we’re about to uncover how to stop just working... and start truly living.
